title: Norwegian-Style Creamy Fish Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful fish soup inspired by traditional Norwegian cuisine. This recipe features succulent fish, tender vegetables, and a rich creamy broth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish fillets and cook until opaque, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Norwegian soup, petit pois, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Note: Be careful not to overcook the fish, as it can become dry and tough.
Also, be sure to check the cooking temperature of the fish to ensure it reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
